description: You read a good answer and it made sense. A month later you cannot rebuild it. Eigma turns the good part of a chat into a wiki you actually remember. Say "organize this into my wiki" and it writes up what is worth keeping and fits it into the structure of what you already know. The wiki grows with you, and pages link themselves along the way. Then it asks you about each page just before you would forget it.

defaultPrompt: Fact-check this, then organize it into my wiki
